ctx.acceptance: TOO_SIMILAR retained; no optimization-gain claim from pure scaling.
ctx.definition: For tasks A/B, r_i = D_i(A)/D_i(B) over shared designs. If max(r)/min(r) <= 1+1e-3 and Spearman=1, classify TOO_SIMILAR.
ctx.name: pure scaling

ctx.acceptance: 4/4 M1-A tasks (3 meta_train + 1 meta_val) separable, otherwise PHYSICAL_TASK_FAMILY_BLOCKED.
ctx.definition: z_i = D_i/mean(D_i); require max|z_A-z_B| >= max(2*U_within, 1e-3) or Spearman < 0.99.
ctx.name: normalized response difference

ctx.acceptance: If all identical and alpha-star differences < 0.1 deg, disclose same feasible region.
ctx.definition: Compare feasible state sets and alpha-star intervals per task/design; report identical regions.
ctx.name: feasible-region difference

ctx.acceptance: If low-CL interpolation uncertainty > 1e-3, densify alpha or obtain A5 pre-signed relaxation.
ctx.definition: Every task/design must have |L-L_ref|/L_ref <= 1e-4 and independent lift residual; report adjacent-three-point quadratic interpolation uncertainty.
ctx.name: lift matching and interpolation

ctx.acceptance: No task is admitted in M0/M0-R; evidence is collected in M1-A.
ctx.definition: Each task needs at least one real VSPAERO record: task fingerprint, raw SHA, geometry SHA, solver version, run_id, starts, internal=7x starts, physics NOT_VALIDATED.
ctx.name: physical-domain evidence

ctx.acceptance: Byte identity checked; rebuild states disclosed.
ctx.definition: Same design across tasks must reuse the same vspgeom bytes; otherwise record rebuild states and apply E2; cross-task comparison is void.
ctx.name: same-geometry bytes

m1a_matrix: 4 M1-A tasks (3 meta_train + 1 meta_val) x 3 reference designs + 1 exact repeat + 2 preflight
non_result_boundary: CTX plan is pre-registration only; no U_within or effect size is measured.
No task is admitted by M0-R; M1-A must collect real evidence.

uncertainty.min_effect_rel_floor_basis: A5 R10 absolute floor; actual min_effect_rel = max(2*U_within, 1e-3) after M1-A repeat
